from seed import SeedPythonOauthInferredRefreshTokenEndpointSecurity

client = SeedPythonOauthInferredRefreshTokenEndpointSecurity(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",

)
client.auth.get_token(
    grant_type="refresh_token",
    refresh_token="my-refresh-token",
)
snippet.async_client:
import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPythonOauthInferredRefreshTokenEndpointSecurity

client = AsyncSeedPythonOauthInferredRefreshTokenEndpointSecurity(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    client_secret="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.auth.get_token(
        grant_type="refresh_token",
        refresh_token="my-refresh-token",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
